Package net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser2

Class RawStyleRule

java.lang.Object
net.sourceforge.plantuml.style.parser2.RawStyleRule
public final class RawStyleRule extends Object
One selector { ... } block, exactly as written in a .skin file: its selector alternatives (or, for an @media block, the raw condition text), the properties declared directly inside it, and its nested blocks. This is a literal, unmerged reading of the file: the same selector path can appear several times across a file (a skin can redeclare mindmapDiagram twice, and a whole @media (prefers-color-scheme:dark) block redeclares several top-level selectors already used above it). Merging those occurrences, expanding comma lists into individual paths, and turning @media into a cascade are all left to the in-memory style model built from this tree, not done here.
